plan.summary: This 1-4 block is a simple off-camp boxing build with one focused full-body session each week. Week 1 establishes a baseline on the main strength lift so future loading can be adjusted cleanly, and the main program starts in Week 2. With only one weekly S&C session and a preference for more conditioning, each workout keeps power first, then strength, then practical accessories, then short conditioning that supports boxing without creating excess soreness.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build general strength, simple power, and repeatable conditioning with beginner-friendly lifts that fit boxing off-camp work.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress the main lifts and power outputs while keeping the weekly workload compact and recoverable.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Keep strength in place and shift more of the emphasis toward faster, sharper explosive work.

exercises.name: Box Jump
exercises.notes: Use a low box you can land on quietly and confidently. Reset between reps and focus on fast takeoff and soft landing.

substitutionOptions.name: Countermovement Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if no stable box is available. Jump hard, land softly, and reset each rep.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Warm up with small jumps in load, then work up to one hard clean set of 3-5 reps. This sets your starting strength baseline for the block, so stop if form breaks and log the load and reps.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then work up to your heaviest clean set of 3-5 reps. Log the load and reps so the app can set your starting baseline for future weeks.

performanceTarget.prompt: Beat the Week 1 baseline later by using more load for the same reps or the same load for more clean reps.

substitutionOptions.name: Double Dumbbell Front Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if your goblet squat is limited by holding position more than your legs.

substitutionOptions.name: Kettlebell Front Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you have kettlebells but no heavy dumbbell.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Floor Press
exercises.notes: Use a steady load that leaves 2 reps in reserve. Pause lightly on the floor, drive up hard, and keep shoulders packed.

substitutionOptions.name: Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use clean full-range reps and stop with 1-2 reps left in the tank.

substitutionOptions.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you have a bench and can set up safely.

exercises.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.notes: Use a load around 2 reps in reserve. Pull the elbow toward the hip, pause briefly at the top, and keep the torso still.

substitutionOptions.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you want more support and less lower-back demand.

substitutionOptions.name: Band Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use only if dumbbells are too limited. Slow the return and squeeze each rep.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Use a moderate load with 2 reps in reserve. Hinge back, keep the dumbbells close, and stop before your back rounds.

substitutionOptions.name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
substitutionOptions.notes: Use bodyweight or light dumbbells if equipment is limited and balance is solid.

substitutionOptions.name: Hip Hinge Good Morning
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a light load and short range if no suitable dumbbells are available.

exercises.name: Weighted Plank
exercises.notes: Brace hard, squeeze glutes, and keep ribs down. Add only enough load to maintain a straight line.

substitutionOptions.name: Hard Plank
substitutionOptions.notes: Use bodyweight only if loading is not practical. Make the brace aggressive.

substitutionOptions.name: Dead Bug
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if floor loading is uncomfortable. Move slowly and keep the lower back flat.

exercises.name: Conditioning Finisher
exercises.notes: Keep the pace strong but controlled. You should finish breathing hard without wrecking the next boxing session.

endurancePrescription.format: 8 rounds of 30 seconds hard, 60 seconds easy
endurancePrescription.mode: shadow boxing, fast step-ups, or jump rope
endurancePrescription.intensity: Hard on the work periods, easy nasal-breathing pace on recovery.

exercises.name: Box Jump
exercises.notes: Stay explosive and crisp. If jump height or landing quality drops, stop the set there.

substitutionOptions.name: Countermovement Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if no stable box is available. Reset every rep.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Use the Week 1 result to pick a load that feels like 2 reps in reserve on the first sets. Keep the torso tall and drive up fast.

performanceTarget.prompt: Track your strongest clean set of 6 and aim for a small improvement in load or rep quality across the block.

substitutionOptions.name: Double Dumbbell Front Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if your strongest leg load is limited by the goblet hold.

substitutionOptions.name: Kettlebell Front Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if kettlebells are your best option.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Floor Press
exercises.notes: Use a load that leaves 1-2 reps in reserve. Lower with control and press hard without losing shoulder position.

substitutionOptions.name: Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Elevate the feet or add a backpack only if normal reps are too easy while still staying clean.

substitutionOptions.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you have a bench and safe setup.

exercises.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.notes: Use a strong but controlled load with 1-2 reps in reserve. No twisting or shrugging.

substitutionOptions.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you want a more stable setup.

substitutionOptions.name: Band Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use higher tension and slow the return if dumbbells are limited.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Stay smooth and keep tension in the hamstrings. Use a moderate load and leave 2 reps in reserve.

substitutionOptions.name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
substitutionOptions.notes: Use light loading and own the balance on both sides.

exercises.name: Suitcase Carry
exercises.notes: Stand tall and do not lean toward the weight. Walk under control and keep the ribs down.

substitutionOptions.name: Farmer Carry
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if one-sided loading is awkward. Keep posture tall and steps controlled.

exercises.name: Conditioning Finisher
exercises.notes: This should build work capacity without turning into sloppy exhaustion.

endurancePrescription.format: 10 rounds of 20 seconds hard, 40 seconds easy
endurancePrescription.mode: shadow boxing, jump rope, or fast step-ups
endurancePrescription.intensity: Fast and sharp on work periods, relaxed and controlled on recovery.

exercises.name: Medicine Ball Chest Pass
exercises.notes: Use a light ball and throw every rep fast. Non-bouncing if indoors or space is limited; reset fully between throws.

substitutionOptions.name: Explosive Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if no medicine ball is available. Keep reps low and land under control.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Use a slightly heavier load than Week 2 if all sets stayed clean. Keep 1-2 reps in reserve and drive hard out of the bottom.

performanceTarget.prompt: Try to improve the best clean set from last week with a small load increase or stronger bar speed.

substitutionOptions.name: Double Dumbbell Front Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if holding one bell limits loading too early.

substitutionOptions.name: Kettlebell Front Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if that setup lets you squat cleaner and heavier.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Floor Press
exercises.notes: Use a solid working load with 1 rep in reserve on the final set. Press hard but keep the rep smooth.

substitutionOptions.name: Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Make it harder with elevation or load only if rep quality stays high.

substitutionOptions.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if available and stable.

exercises.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.notes: Pull with control and finish with the upper arm tight to the body. Leave 1-2 reps in reserve.

substitutionOptions.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you want less torso fatigue.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Use a moderate-heavy load with clean hinge mechanics. Stop the set if the lower back takes over.

substitutionOptions.name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if load is limited and you can stay balanced.

exercises.name: Weighted Plank
exercises.notes: Brace as if taking a body shot. Keep the body rigid and stop before the hips sag.

substitutionOptions.name: Hard Plank
substitutionOptions.notes: Use bodyweight if loading is awkward.

exercises.name: Conditioning Finisher
exercises.notes: Keep the rhythm honest. Hard efforts should still look sharp and coordinated.

endurancePrescription.format: 6 rounds of 90 seconds moderate-hard, 60 seconds easy
endurancePrescription.intensity: Work at a sustained pace you can repeat cleanly across all rounds.

exercises.name: Box Jump
exercises.notes: Keep every rep fast and easy. This week is for freshness, not fatigue.

substitutionOptions.name: Countermovement Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if no stable box is available.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Use about 10% less load than Week 3 or stop with 3 reps still in reserve. Move smoothly and leave feeling better than you started.

performanceTarget.prompt: Use this week to move cleanly and recover. Save the next push for the following block.

substitutionOptions.name: Double Dumbbell Front Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if that setup feels more comfortable.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Floor Press
exercises.notes: Use a lighter load than last week and keep 3 reps in reserve. Smooth reps only.

substitutionOptions.name: Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use controlled reps and stop well before failure.

exercises.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.notes: Use a comfortable load and squeeze each rep. No grinding this week.

substitutionOptions.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you want an easier setup on the lower back.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Keep the load light-moderate and the hinge crisp. This is deload work, not a test.

substitutionOptions.name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a light version if equipment is limited.

exercises.name: Suitcase Carry
exercises.notes: Tall posture, steady steps, controlled breathing.

substitutionOptions.name: Farmer Carry
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if bilateral loading is easier to set up.

exercises.name: Conditioning Finisher
exercises.notes: Finish feeling worked but fresh. This is a deload dose.

endurancePrescription.mode: shadow boxing, jump rope, or step-ups
endurancePrescription.intensity: Moderate effort only. Stay relaxed and rhythmic.
